groups.activity: buy the Pyrana Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Pyrana Prime is in Prime Resurgence

live.text: vaulted; only during her Prime Resurgence

rows.label: Pyrana Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Blueprint relics: every one carries it as the Rare

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Pyrana Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Axi P1 or Axi P2 or Axi P3 or Lith P1 or Lith P2 or Lith P7 or Meso P1 or Meso P6, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Pyrana Prime Barrel
rows.note: Axi A8 or Axi C4 or Lith L2 or Lith L3 or Meso E2 or Meso N7 or Neo A2 or Neo A9 or Neo V7, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Pyrana Prime Receiver
rows.note: Axi C3 or Axi D3 or Axi K3 or Lith D5 or Neo C1 or Neo G2 or Neo Z2, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

conditions: Refine Blueprint and Receiver relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Barrel relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
